title: The KYC Gate
description: Three require() calls in Ondo Finance's CashKYCSenderReceiver block every address that isn't KYC-verified. Toggle wallet type and compliance model to see which $5B+ tokenized treasury tokens an AI agent can — and can't — reach.
controls: Sender: toggle between AI Agent and KYC Institution to see which gates pass or fail
Token: switch between Permissioned (OUSG · BUIDL) and Blocklist (USDY) compliance models
